title: Pills handed out during intuitive communication training
summary: Dan Sherman tells of Pills handed out during intuitive communication training, about early 1990s at Undisclosed facility near the NSA complex, Maryland, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Undisclosed facility near the NSA complex, Maryland

tellings.quote: And so, and he told me also there would be some pills that I would take.

plain: Dan Sherman, a former sergeant, says the NSA, the US spy agency that intercepts communications, hired him to talk to aliens. He says that in the early 1990s he trained in "intuitive communication," meaning receiving messages with his mind, at an unnamed site near the NSA's headquarters in Maryland. He says an officer he calls Captain White told him he would also be given some pills to take as part of the training.
